data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.name: DebugSwift
data_tooling.summary: DebugSwift 是一款开源 iOS 调试工具包，旨在简化应用崩溃、内存泄漏等常见问题的定位与解决。它通过实时视觉覆盖层进行布局检查，并自动检测内存泄漏，使调试过程比传统控制台日志更直观。开发者可通过 CocoaPods 集成，在开发阶段监控应用性能，从而加速迭代并构建更稳定的 iOS 应用。该工具特别适合需要快速调试界面布局或优化内存管理的场景，让开发工作更高效。
data_tooling.summary_en: DebugSwift is an open-source iOS debugging toolkit that simplifies identifying and resolving common app issues like crashes and memory leaks. It provides real-time visual overlays for layout inspection and automated leak detection, making debugging more intuitive than traditional console logs. Developers can integrate it via CocoaPods to monitor app performance during development, enabling faster iteration and more robust iOS applications.

ui_devex.name: MTProxy
ui_devex.summary: MTProxy是一个轻量级代理服务器，专门用于通过安全中继Telegram流量来绕过网络审查。其技术核心在于采用MTProto协议并内置流量混淆技术，将代理数据伪装成普通HTTPS流量，从而有效规避防火墙检测。开发者可将它部署在云服务器上创建个人访问节点，通过修改C语言代码实现自定义路由规则，或将其集成到网络监控工具中，实际研究流量混淆的实现机制。
ui_devex.summary_en: MTProxy is a lightweight proxy server designed to bypass internet censorship by securely relaying Telegram traffic through intermediary servers. Its technical innovation lies in using the MTProto protocol with built-in obfuscation techniques that disguise proxy traffic as ordinary HTTPS, making it harder for firewalls to detect and block. Developers can deploy it on cloud servers to create personal access points, modify its C codebase for custom routing rules, or integrate it into network monitoring tools to study traffic obfuscation methods in practice.

ui_devex.name: aios-core
ui_devex.summary: AIOS-Core是一个JavaScript框架，专门用于简化AI驱动的全栈应用开发，通过协调多个AI智能体来实现复杂任务。其核心设计理念是将AI智能体视为可组合的模块化组件，开发者可以通过清晰的API将它们连接起来，构建自动化工作流而无需深入研究底层AI技术。该框架采用TypeScript/Node.js开发，适合创建内容生成系统、智能客服机器人等实际应用，让开发者能够快速实验多智能体协作模式，将前沿AI能力融入日常开发实践。
ui_devex.summary_en: AIOS-Core is a JavaScript framework that simplifies building AI-powered full-stack applications by orchestrating multiple AI agents. Its key innovation is treating AI agents as modular components that can be chained together through a clean API, enabling complex workflows without deep AI expertise. Developers can use it to create automated systems like content generators or customer service bots by defining agent roles and interactions in TypeScript/Node.js, making advanced AI accessible for practical web development projects.

Developers can deploy it on cloud servers to create personal access points, modify its C codebase for custom routing rules, or integrate it into network monitoring tools to study traffic obfuscation methods in practice.

framework_core.name: slime
framework_core.summary: SLIME 是一个专为大型语言模型（LLM）设计的强化学习（RL）后训练框架，旨在解决LLM在复杂目标对齐中的扩展难题。它通过优化RL在LLM中的应用策略，例如定制奖励模型和策略优化方法，提升训练稳定性和效果，让模型能更好地适应多样化任务。开发者可利用该框架对预训练模型进行微调，应用于创意写作或代码生成等场景，通过自定义奖励函数引导模型行为，实现更精准的目标对齐。
framework_core.summary_en: SLIME is an open-source framework designed to scale reinforcement learning (RL) for large language models (LLMs) during post-training, addressing the challenge of efficiently aligning LLMs with complex objectives beyond basic instruction following. Its technical innovation lies in optimizing RL scaling strategies specifically for LLMs, enabling more stable and effective training through tailored reward modeling and policy optimization techniques. Researchers and developers can use SLIME to fine-tune pre-trained LLMs for specialized tasks like creative writing or code generation, experimenting with custom reward functions to shape model behavior toward specific goals.

framework_core.name: DebugSwift
framework_core.summary: DebugSwift 是一款开源 iOS 调试工具包，旨在简化应用崩溃、内存泄漏等常见问题的定位与解决。它通过实时视觉覆盖层进行布局检查，并自动检测内存泄漏，使调试过程比传统控制台日志更直观。开发者可通过 CocoaPods 集成，在开发阶段监控应用性能，从而加速迭代并构建更稳定的 iOS 应用。该工具特别适合需要快速调试界面布局或优化内存管理的场景，让开发工作更高效。
framework_core.summary_en: DebugSwift is an open-source iOS debugging toolkit that simplifies identifying and resolving common app issues like crashes and memory leaks. It provides real-time visual overlays for layout inspection and automated leak detection, making debugging more intuitive than traditional console logs. Developers can integrate it via CocoaPods to monitor app performance during development, enabling faster iteration and more robust iOS applications.

framework_core.name: aios-core
framework_core.summary: AIOS-Core是一个JavaScript框架，专门用于简化AI驱动的全栈应用开发，通过协调多个AI智能体来实现复杂任务。其核心设计理念是将AI智能体视为可组合的模块化组件，开发者可以通过清晰的API将它们连接起来，构建自动化工作流而无需深入研究底层AI技术。该框架采用TypeScript/Node.js开发，适合创建内容生成系统、智能客服机器人等实际应用，让开发者能够快速实验多智能体协作模式，将前沿AI能力融入日常开发实践。
framework_core.summary_en: AIOS-Core is a JavaScript framework that simplifies building AI-powered full-stack applications by orchestrating multiple AI agents. Its key innovation is treating AI agents as modular components that can be chained together through a clean API, enabling complex workflows without deep AI expertise. Developers can use it to create automated systems like content generators or customer service bots by defining agent roles and interactions in TypeScript/Node.js, making advanced AI accessible for practical web development projects.

framework_core.name: superhuman
framework_core.summary: Superhuman是一篇研究论文，探讨AI智能体如何在NetHack等复杂环境中实现超人类表现。该研究通过将大语言模型与强化学习相结合，展示了智能体如何发展出复杂的规划与探索策略。这种方法的核心在于利用语言模型的推理能力指导强化学习的探索过程，使智能体能够理解环境语义并制定长期策略。研究人员可借鉴此框架研究AI系统的涌现行为，将其应用于机器人控制或科学发现等需要自主决策的领域，探索智能体在开放环境中的能力边界。
framework_core.summary_en: Superhuman is a research paper exploring how AI agents can achieve superhuman performance in complex environments like NetHack. It demonstrates that combining large language models with reinforcement learning enables agents to develop sophisticated planning and exploration strategies. Researchers can use this framework to study emergent behaviors in AI systems, applying similar approaches to robotics or scientific discovery tasks where autonomous decision-making is crucial.

agents_workflows.summary: AIOS-Core是一个JavaScript框架，专门用于简化AI驱动的全栈应用开发，通过协调多个AI智能体来实现复杂任务。其核心设计理念是将AI智能体视为可组合的模块化组件，开发者可以通过清晰的API将它们连接起来，构建自动化工作流而无需深入研究底层AI技术。该框架采用TypeScript/Node.js开发，适合创建内容生成系统、智能客服机器人等实际应用，让开发者能够快速实验多智能体协作模式，将前沿AI能力融入日常开发实践。
agents_workflows.summary_en: AIOS-Core is a JavaScript framework that simplifies building AI-powered full-stack applications by orchestrating multiple AI agents. Its key innovation is treating AI agents as modular components that can be chained together through a clean API, enabling complex workflows without deep AI expertise. Developers can use it to create automated systems like content generators or customer service bots by defining agent roles and interactions in TypeScript/Node.js, making advanced AI accessible for practical web development projects.

agents_workflows.name: superhuman
agents_workflows.summary: Superhuman是一篇研究论文，探讨AI智能体如何在NetHack等复杂环境中实现超人类表现。该研究通过将大语言模型与强化学习相结合，展示了智能体如何发展出复杂的规划与探索策略。这种方法的核心在于利用语言模型的推理能力指导强化学习的探索过程，使智能体能够理解环境语义并制定长期策略。研究人员可借鉴此框架研究AI系统的涌现行为，将其应用于机器人控制或科学发现等需要自主决策的领域，探索智能体在开放环境中的能力边界。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Superhuman is a research paper exploring how AI agents can achieve superhuman performance in complex environments like NetHack. It demonstrates that combining large language models with reinforcement learning enables agents to develop sophisticated planning and exploration strategies. Researchers can use this framework to study emergent behaviors in AI systems, applying similar approaches to robotics or scientific discovery tasks where autonomous decision-making is crucial.
